visualCharacteristics.purpose: cards-industry-panel: per-industry tab panel with an industry banner tile followed by 4 product tiles
visualCharacteristics.structure: 1 image-overlay industry tile (name + 'Shop All') + 4 product tiles (image, price, title, CTA) in one 5-column row

contentPattern.structure: row 1: [industry photo] | [industry name, 'Shop All' link]; rows 2+: [product image] | [price, product title link, 'Select Options' link]. One block per tab panel (section-metadata tab-id/tab-title)
